name: The Salt Marches
description: An example data pack. Every entry is invented for this file, and shows one of the four kinds of content a pack can carry.

conditions.name: Waterlogged
conditions.summary: Soaked through and slowed by the weight of it.
lines: The creature's speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity checks.
Ends when the creature spends a short rest somewhere dry.
conditions.note: Invented content. Nothing here is from any published book.

diseases.name: Dock Fever
diseases.summary: A shivering sickness picked up in the harbour.
lines: On a failed DC 12 Constitution save, the creature contracts the disease.
While infected, it gains one level of exhaustion that a long rest does not remove.
A DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check ends the disease on a success.
diseases.note: Invented content, written to show the shape of a disease entry.

entries.name: Echoing Spell
entries.summary: The spell repeats, faintly, one round later.
lines: When you cast a spell that deals damage, it echoes at the start of your next turn.
The echo deals half the original damage to one creature that was in the area.
entries.note: This group id matches the one the app already ships, so the option joins the Metamagic tab instead of making a new one.

abilityGroups.title: Tidal Boons
abilityGroups.blurb: Favours the marsh grants to those who bargain with it.

entries.name: Salt Blessing
entries.meta: Salt Marches · Once per long rest
entries.summary: Reroll a failed save while standing in salt water.
lines: When you fail a saving throw while in contact with salt water, you may reroll it and must use the new result.

entries.name: Marsh Step
entries.summary: Mud and shallow water are not difficult terrain for you.
lines: You ignore difficult terrain caused by mud, silt or water no deeper than your knees.

rules.title: Sailing

items.text: A vessel needs half its crew slots filled to move at all, and all of them to make its full speed.
A pilot who fails a DC 13 Wisdom (Survival) check in shallow water runs the vessel aground. Freeing it takes an hour.

tables.caption: What the tide brings in
head: d6
Find
rows: A sealed clay jar, still full.
Rigging from a ship nobody recognises.
A drowned sailor's boots, the right size.
Fish, and enough of them to sell.
A chart with one island marked and no name.
Nothing, for the third day running.

rules.note: Invented content. A rules section can carry items, tables, or both.
